alert.rationale: Alert sets 60-80; consequence of CHF 47,344 places it at 76. Band RED.

scale.note: The score is a projection of the five-level ladder, not a second model. 20 points per rung; the fraction inside a rung is relative consequence within today's book and never crosses a rung boundary.

bands.action: Warning; evaluate an alternate route or schedule change.

layer1_event.probability_basis: statutory and calendared; not an estimate

assessment.pathway_headline: Delay only — nothing in this consignment is harmed by the event.

delay.reason: Delay applies to every consignment on this corridor, whatever is in the box.

damage.reason: Regulatory change cannot harm goods — it only delays them.

assessment.exposure_explanation: Just-in-time / just-in-sequence (OEM): CHF 15,000 the moment the window is missed, then CHF 15,000/day. 51.8 h chargeable — CHF 47,344.

clashes_resolved.title: Severe event, invulnerable cargo
clashes_resolved.resolution: Scored on delay alone. The event cannot harm this consignment, but it can still make it late, and both halves of that are reported.

clashes_resolved.title: Critical channel, no cargo risk
clashes_resolved.resolution: The channel's consequence stands in full — a stopped line costs the same whatever was on the pallet — but it does not manufacture a cargo risk that physics says is absent.

clashes_resolved.title: Regulation blocks the standard mitigation
clashes_resolved.resolution: The action was removed rather than offered. A plan that cannot legally be executed costs the planner the hours they had left.

root_cause.title: Weekend heavy-vehicle driving ban in force 00:00 Sun – 22:00 Sun
root_cause.verbatim_quote: Heavy goods vehicles above 7.5 t may not be operated on Sundays and public holidays between 00:00 and 22:00.

recommended_actions.action: Depart Friday 18:00 ahead of the ban window
recommended_actions.decide_by: Decide by Fri 18 Sep 14:00 UTC (8 h)

recommended_actions.action: Apply for a Sonntagsfahrverbot exemption (ADR hardship)
recommended_actions.decide_by: Decide by Fri 18 Sep 10:00 UTC (4 h)

suppressed_actions.label: Air cargo
suppressed_actions.reason: ADR Class 3 — flammable liquid may not move by Air cargo.

data_quality.note: A null probability is an event whose odds cannot be sourced from anything defensible. Do NOT coerce it to 0.5 or to any other default; render it as unsourced. Every CHF figure is modelled, not invoiced.

delivery.auth: Bearer token from the environment of the POSTing process. No credential appears in this payload by design.
delivery.retry: exponential backoff; the idempotency_key makes replay safe
